Commit 33b409a4b6d544598262f2f074ebb4b6dc466157 later converted the spreadsheet search parameters to source/guidanceresponse/bundle-GuidanceResponse-search-params.xml and carried both expression and XPath forward.
additional_context: GuidanceResponse is active in source/fhir.ini. Later SearchParameter model commits renamed xpathUsage to processingMode and then removed XPath usage from SearchParameter and the GuidanceResponse search-parameter bundle, so the current absence of XPath is intentional current-model behavior rather than an unapplied part of FHIR-18081. The originating Zulip thread matches the Jira request and Confluence searches found no conflicting meeting evidence.
